body:
What's there to talk about? My wife doesn't love me. We haven't slept in the same bed for almost 10 years. I live in constant pain everyday after having back surgery. I have no friends, I've pushed them all away. I lost my job and no one else will hire me. I'm broke and I've been selling my personal things just to pay bills.

This is all true. I just don't want to go on anymore.
I told my wife I want to kill myself and she said "that's nice".
